thread:
marta: quick heads-up — Solaris trial starts Mon. Need final perf/W + kernel-tune checklist. who can lead the measurement plan?

ajay: i can own the perf matrix. will draft rows: model, batch, seqlen, quant, kernel-flag.

kevin: important to capture tail latency for small batch sizes too. add p95/p99. also need exact kernel build flags we’ll test.

marta: yes p95/p99 included. kevin — can you post the kernel flags you want tried?

kevin: plan: 
```
CONFIG_AVX2=1
USE_TENSOR_CORES=1
KERNEL_OPT_LEVEL=3
PATCH=solar-kern-v2.patch
```
start with that then a conservative fallback build.

alex: for power we’ll use the datalogger v2 on rack A3. timeline: 30s sample, sync NTP, record ambient. will anyone own probe mounting?

sophie (Solaris): Solaris can ship 2x external Wattmeters and a probe mount kit. we need mounting coords and sample cadence. ambient note: our lab runs 21±1C.

nora: i’ll coordinate marketplace/announcements copy. timeline: don’t publish results until partner sign-off + legal OK. can we set a hard freeze date for public numbers?

marta: freeze target = Fri EOD after run (Fri 1700 PT). partner signoff by Thu noon if possible.

ajay: draft of perf matrix posted: https://redwood.internal/bench/matrices/solaristest (wip)

kevin: quick command we’ll run for throughput baseline:
```bash
run_bench --model gpt-3-small --bs 8 --seq 1024 --workers 4 --gpu-mode kernel_opt
```
collect: tokens/s, p50/p95/p99, watts, socket temps.

bench-bot: CI note — smoke run on test harness passed: 4 runs, median throughput 3.2k tok/s, no OOMs. logs: /ci/runs/solarismoke/1723456701

marta: great. can someone own telemetry dashboard panels? need per-request latency, perf/w, kernel build id, and git commit for patch.

kevin: assigning to me and ajay. kevin -> kernel metadata. ajay -> perf/w charts.

alex: reminder re: measurement methodology doc — use same workload seeds for accuracy comparisons, and include a synthetic tail test with random seqlens.

sophie (Solaris): sending lab coordinates and wattmeter serials by EOD. can we get instructions for mounting + a short checklist for on-site techs?

nora: will draft the partner-facing checklist + embargo language. will loop in legal.

marta: action items summary:
- ajay: finalize perf matrix + runbook (due Sun EOD)
- kevin: kernel builds + patch list + metadata tagging (due Sun EOD)
- alex: power measurement runbook + probe mount diagram (due Mon morning)
- nora: partner comms + embargo wording (due Mon morning)
- sophie: provide wattmeter serials + mount kit (by EOD)
- bench-bot: run nightly smoke and post aggregate to /dashboards/solaristest

ajay: noted. will ping if matrix needs changes. :thumbsup:

kevin: one more — can we lock the env (cuda, driver) to exact versions? small diffs change perf.

marta: yes — use CUDA 12.1, NVIDIA driver 535.113, glibc pinned to 2.35. add to runbook.

sophie (Solaris): acknowledged. looking forward to Monday.

marta: thanks all — we’ll do a short call tomorrow 11am PT to walk the checklist. agenda in calendar.

ajay: see you then.
